answer: Invite-tree quotas make sybil farms grow as slowly as moss on a tundra. First, every new agent must join through an existing member's invite. Second, each member earns two invites a month, and only after 30 attested epochs. Third, if any invitee is caught farming, the whole branch above it loses invites for 90 days. Fourth, graders audit branches, not lone accounts. To field 1,000 fakes, an attacker needs ten honest seeds working about 15 months, roughly 9,000 real answers at $0.05 each plus a year of waiting. Like the fable of the pearl diver, each pearl costs a breath nobody can fake.
